description: READ-REFRESH, the staleness boundary and the 1001-versus-1002 ladder (r-lock-3-4-txn/read-refresh-elapsed and -ladder were single samples). Process b holds snapshot, dynaset and table cursors over rows 1, 2, 64. Process a updates N of row 1 by an implicit statement (+1000); b looks (Move 0, read, new snapshot) at cumulative 0.25, 1, 2.5, 4, 5.5 and 7 s, then Idle(dbRefreshCache) and looks. a then makes five more implicit updates (+1 each, 100 ms apart); b Idle and looks, pauses 7 s and looks, Idle and looks. Asks the first time each cursor kind shows the new value and what Idle makes visible after several updates.
